description: This file contains core graph-building functionality for PyTorch's Dynamo system, including classes and functions for constructing, managing, and compiling FX graphs during TorchScript compilation and export. It defines key components like OutputGraph, SubgraphTracer, and supporting data structures for handling guards, sources, variables, and graph compilation context. The module integrates with FX, autograd, symbolic shapes, and other PyTorch internals to facilitate advanced graph transformations, tracing, and optimization.

classes.name: OutputGraph
classes.description: Represents a compiled and optimized FX graph including methods for code generation, validation, cleanup, and metadata management within Dynamo's graph compilation system.

classes.name: InstructionTranslatorBase
classes.description: Base class for managing the translation of FX graphs into executable instructions, handling codegen, side effects, and graph execution control.

classes.name: SubgraphTracer
classes.description: FX tracer responsible for constructing FX graphs during Dynamo tracing, supporting export mode, source management, and graph building.

methods.name: None codegen_cells(self, tx: "InstructionTranslatorBase", cg: PyCodegen)
methods.description: Generates instructions to load closure variables or cell contents into the codegen for a subgraph.

methods.name: None codegen_suffix( self, tx: "InstructionTranslatorBase", stack_values: list[VariableTracker], cg: PyCodegen, log_side_effects: bool, )
methods.description: Appends codegen instructions to handle side effects, backward state, and finalize code generation for a subgraph.

methods.name: None cleanup_graph(self)
methods.description: Removes graph metadata related to node creation timestamps and redundant grad-enabled nodes, cleaning up the FX graph.

methods.name: None bypass_package(self, reason: str = "", **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Skips saving a graph to the package cache, optionally logs and raises errors based on config.

methods.name: get_graph_sizes_structured
methods.description: Returns a structured dictionary with sizes of example tensors from fake tensor nodes in the graph.

methods.name: get_graph_sizes
methods.description: Returns a string report of tensor sizes within the FX graph, highlighting symbolic sizes.

methods.name: run_compiler_collective
methods.description: Performs distributed synchronization and state gathering for the compiler collective operation.

methods.name: list[Instruction] compile_and_call_fx_graph( self, tx: "InstructionTranslatorBase", rv: list[VariableTracker], root: FakeRootModule, )
methods.description: Generates executable code for the current FX graph, validates autograd requirements, optionally compiles a backend function, and returns instructions to call it.

methods.name: CompiledFn call_user_compiler( self, gm: fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: list[Tensor] )
methods.description: Invokes the user-provided backend compiler function within a timed context.

methods.name: CompiledFn _call_user_compiler( self, gm: fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: list[Tensor] )
methods.description: Handles the actual invocation of the user-defined compiler, including source tracking, source validation, and error handling.
